reviews.title: Gimme a refund🤣
reviews.comment: Was the last piece I needed to complete my gaming PC. Haven't been able to game, was so excited to once the part Come only to find out the motherboard does not function and the screen only goes black. Can't pull up a bios or even update it as there is no download anywhere (in USA) as the website is from Japan or China. Very sad to have wasted 86 dollars on this. Still have no video game.
reviews.author: Kameron Proctor

reviews.title: Does not seem to work for Windows 11 Old bios that you cant update
reviews.comment: The motherboard has worked, which is a positive. The issue is that the BIOS is from 1/11/23, and am unable to find a way to update it. So you can't enable XMP to be able to upgrade to Windows 11. Making it essentially not a viable option for 2025
reviews.author: ryland reed
